title: Design: Close refused when the work order changed shows the message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer with every line Complete, made for this test.
  • Have the work order open in two browser tabs.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow1-20-7e-close-work-order-changed.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click Close Work Order in the first tab.
  2. Set Shop supplies to a new amount (for example $30.00) in the second tab.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the window of the first tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Close window opens.

Step 2:

  • The new amount is saved.

Step 3:

  • Close is refused with the message "This work order changed. Review and close again."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-E5: “If lines, the shop supplies amount or the classification change after the confirmation opens, Close is refused with "This work order changed. Review and close again."”
